opening.argument: The presentation leads with a concrete daily-return promise: “Get 7-8 BNB / day with BNB (Binance) Flash Loan Arbitrage | Tutorial | Earn $2000/DAY,” alongside a claim that viewers will earn “approximately 200-300% profit.” It also reports that “from a 0.4 BNB investment, I earned back 6.7 BNB on the flash loan,” while presenting the method as requiring only a relatively small BNB amount. Viewers are directed to obtain and copy an external smart-contract file, then return to Remix to launch the flash-loan operation. The procedure calls for selecting 0.5 BNB, or possibly 0.4 BNB, and the supplied frames show deployment controls and a wallet-confirmation panel. These materials present substantial returns through a low-risk-seeming process, but neither the claimed returns nor the separate reward banner is established as verified or connected to the tutorial.
